protocol.task: reverse four-symbol source sequence; decoder predicts reversed content then EOS
protocol.optimizer: full-batch SGD, no momentum or weight decay
protocol.training: teacher forcing only; mean over non-PAD targets including EOS
protocol.selection: none; validation descriptive; fixed final checkpoint for all six runs
protocol.decoding: greedy; unfiltered full8-class argmax, stop first EOS, max10 emitted tokens; no gold length used
protocol.diagnostic: predeclared encoder-context zeroing at inference, no retraining; not an equal-capacity model
protocol.encoder: BOS+source+EOS; freeze hidden state at right padding
protocol.decoder: initial state=encoder final; BOS then preceding gold token during training; own output during inference
